name: ILMERA Study Abroad
description: ILMERA Study Abroad provides online-only counselling for Indian students, with no counselling premises.
countries_note: Published destination guidance covers Germany, Italy, the UK, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia and the GCC. GCC business support spans UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain; official-source coverage has the separate limits stated on the GCC page.
